# f8 Social Club

> f8 Social Club for Professionals is an in-person social club in Surrey, BC, hosted by Faith Morante.

## Pages

- https://f8social.club/ : Home. Free weekly coworking and board game nights for professionals in Surrey, BC.
- https://f8social.club/meetups-in-surrey : Meetups in Surrey we host. Free Monday coworking, 6:30–8:00 PM Pacific (America/Vancouver, UTC-7), at Chai Coffee Company, 11088 126a St #100, Surrey. Free Thursday board game night, 6:30–8:00 PM Pacific (UTC-7), at Central City Mall food court, 10153 King George Blvd, Surrey. RSVP on Meetup. This page is our social club, not a directory of every group in Surrey.
- https://f8social.club/coworking-surrey : Free coworking every Monday, 6:30–8:00 PM Pacific (America/Vancouver, UTC-7), at Chai Coffee Company, 11088 126a St #100, Surrey, BC V3V 0G3.
- https://f8social.club/board-game-night-surrey : Free board game night every Thursday, 6:30–8:00 PM Pacific (UTC-7), at Central City Mall food court, 10153 King George Blvd, Surrey, BC V3T 2W1.
- https://f8social.club/events : Upcoming weekly series and dated events.
- https://f8social.club/events/whitecaps-watch-party-2026-11-07 : Free Whitecaps vs CF Montréal watch party, Saturday November 7, 2026, 2:00 PM Pacific (UTC-7), at Browns Socialhouse Surrey Centre, 9666 King George Blvd A1, Surrey, BC.
- https://f8social.club/about : About the club and founder Faith Morante.
- https://f8social.club/links : Link-in-bio page linked from Meetup and Instagram.

## Facts

- Who: f8 Social Club for Professionals, hosted by Faith Morante (f8social.club)
- What: in-person social events for professionals
- When: coworking every Monday and board game night every Thursday, 6:30–8:00 PM Pacific Time (America/Vancouver, UTC-7 year-round)
- Where: Surrey, BC
- Price: Monday coworking, Thursday board game night, and the Whitecaps watch party are free.
- RSVP: https://www.meetup.com/coworking-surrey-hosted-by-morantech/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/socialclub.pros/
